name: wal_block_size
description: The fixed block size used for WAL (Write-Ahead Log) files, determined at PostgreSQL compile time.
symptoms: WAL file corruption if mismatched with compiled value
Startup failure when restoring from backup with incompatible block size
Inability to use WAL archives from different PostgreSQL builds
tuning_tips: This parameter is read-only and cannot be tuned at runtime or via configuration; it must match the compile-time setting of the PostgreSQL binary. Ensure consistency across clusters, backups, and replication setups.
